problem_text:
A city planner needs to distribute a fixed budget across 17 infrastructure projects to maximize the overall community benefit score.  
The characteristics of each project are as follows:  
* Project A: benefit score is 0.177, impact factor is 0.083, allocation limits [0.055, 0.430]  
* Project B: benefit score is 0.069, impact factor is 0.157, allocation limits [0.024, 0.321]  
* Project C: benefit score is 0.133, impact factor is 0.144, allocation limits [0.095, 0.705]  
* Project D: benefit score is 0.073, impact factor is 0.031, allocation limits [0.014, 0.430]  
* Project E: benefit score is 0.185, impact factor is 0.211, allocation limits [0.082, 0.718]  
* Project F: benefit score is 0.146, impact factor is 0.227, allocation limits [0.084, 0.802]  
* Project G: benefit score is 0.150, impact factor is 0.121, allocation limits [0.017, 0.787]  
* Project H: benefit score is 0.059, impact factor is 0.226, allocation limits [0.002, 0.685]  
* Project I: benefit score is 0.109, impact factor is 0.258, allocation limits [0.010, 0.730]  
* Project J: benefit score is 0.199, impact factor is 0.125, allocation limits [0.029, 0.838]  
* Project K: benefit score is 0.120, impact factor is 0.013, allocation limits [0.053, 0.534]  
* Project L: benefit score is 0.199, impact factor is 0.043, allocation limits [0.039, 0.485]  
* Project M: benefit score is 0.034, impact factor is 0.276, allocation limits [0.008, 0.331]  
* Project N: benefit score is 0.039, impact factor is 0.105, allocation limits [0.076, 0.303]  
* Project O: benefit score is 0.158, impact factor is 0.227, allocation limits [0.068, 0.763]  
* Project P: benefit score is 0.079, impact factor is 0.151, allocation limits [0.015, 0.760]  
* Project Q: benefit score is 0.101, impact factor is 0.030, allocation limits [0.036, 0.857]  

Each project must receive a fraction of the total budget within its specified limits, and all fractions must sum to one. To ensure balanced development, the group of essential projects, represented by the set E = {B, D, G, M, N, P, Q}, must collectively receive at least 0.343 of the total budget.  
Additionally, the total impact factor of the portfolio must not exceed 0.162, and the overall benefit score must be at least 0.085.  
Determine the optimal budget allocation that maximizes the total benefit score while satisfying all constraints.
